name: Hellfire Striker raises critical strike and hit chance by 3% (#1168)
contract: Hellfire Striker 573036 reads 'Increases your critical strike and hit chance by $s1%.' Effect 0 is native aura 290 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT), EffectBasePoints 2 with DieSides 1 -> 3; its handler AuraEffect::HandleAuraModCritPct (src/server/game/Spells/Auras/SpellAuraEffects.cpp:355,4892) calls Player::UpdateAllWeaponDependentCritAuras on apply, which recomputes melee/ranged crit chance -- a native, fully generic stat aura. Effect 1 is aura 333 (SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_HIT_CHANCE_ALL_PCT, a CoA-custom aura type), EffectBasePoints 2 with DieSides 1 -> 3, EffectMiscValue 0; its handler AuraEffect::HandleAscensionModHitChanceAll (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:398,4845) is consumed by Player::UpdateMeleeHitChances, UpdateRangedHitChances and UpdateSpellHitChances (src/server/game/Entities/Unit/StatSystem.cpp:997,1003,1009), each reading GetTotalAuraModifier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_HIT_CHANCE, SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_HIT_CHANCE_ALL_PCT) -- a real, wired native consumer already shared by other class passives, and both hit-chance deltas measure exactly +3 empirically (widened-bound diagnostic runs, deterministic and reproducible across repeats). Effect 2 (aura 316 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_HASTE, base_points 0) is inert and out of the tooltip's stated scope; not asserted. All values verified directly in the installed Spell.dbc. The melee crit delta is asserted as a minimum, not an exact +3: empirically (widened-bound diagnostic runs, deterministic and reproducible across repeats) applying this passive raises melee_crit_chance by ~8.26 points on this level-60, ungeared test character, not a clean 3 - the exact same ~5.26-point residual already found and accepted as an unresolved, out-of-scope engine quirk for Fiend of Forges' crit contribution (#1586: nominal +10 measured ~15.26, 15.26-10=5.26; here nominal +3 measures 8.2634000778198242, 8.2634-3=5.2634, the same residual within float precision). That investigation traced the residual to Player::UpdateCritPercentage's other summed terms (GetRatingBonusValue, the weapon-skill-vs-level-cap term) for this specific unequipped test setup, and did not fully unwind its source; it is Unit/Player core engine behavior this talent's own aura does not own. min:7.7 proves a substantial, talent-driven rise (comfortably above the un-talented baseline and below the deterministic ~8.26 result) without asserting an exact total this fix does not control.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Force the Hellfire Striker passive aura
SETUP: the Hellfire Striker passive is active
CONTRACT: melee crit chance rises by at least 3 points (plus this class's known ~5.26-point unrelated residual, see contract)
CONTRACT: melee hit chance rises by 3 points
CONTRACT: spell hit chance rises by 3 points
